title: A C¹ map is (c + η)-Lipschitz on small balls around a point where ‖Df‖ ≤ c
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, x ∈ ℝ^P and δ, c ∈ ℝ with δ > 0. Suppose f is C¹ on the open ball B_δ(x) and its Fréchet derivative at x (Mathlib fderiv ℝ f x) has operator norm ‖Df(x)‖ ≤ c. Then for every η > 0 there is s with 0 < s ≤ δ such that |f(y) − f(z)| ≤ (c + η)|y − z| for all y, z ∈ B_s(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P) (δ c : ℝ), 0 < δ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball x δ) → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ c → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball x s, ∀ z ∈ ball x s, ‖f y - f z‖ ≤ (c + η) * ‖y - z‖
